traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description:
When you reach character level 3, you can transform as a Bonus Action|XPHB using one of the options below (choose the option each time you transform). The transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required). Once you transform, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Once on each of your turns before the transformation ends, you can deal extra damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and the extra damage's type is either Necrotic for Necrotic Shroud or Radiant for Heavenly Wings and Inner Radiance.

Here are the transformation options:

- **Heavenly Wings**

Two spectral wings sprout from your back temporarily. Until the transformation ends, you have a Fly Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB.
- **Inner Radiance**

Searing light temporarily radiates from your eyes and mouth. For the duration, you shed Bright Light|XPHB in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.
- **Necrotic Shroud**

Your eyes briefly become pools of darkness, and flightless wings sprout from your back temporarily. Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Discipline.

You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

Strength in Unity.

If you fail a D20 Test|XPHB, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

War and Peace.

You gain proficiency in two of the following skills: Athletics, History, Intimidation, Performance.

traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Brave.

You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

Long-Limbed.

When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

Powerful Build.

You have Advantage|XPHB on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Stand by the Strong.

When an ally within 30 feet that can see you fails a saving throw to avoid or end the Frightened condition, you can use your Reaction|XPHB to allow them to reroll the saving throw.

name: Gnoll
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Bite.

Your teeth are natural weapons, which you can use to make Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes. If you hit with them, you deal Piercing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your Unarmed Strike|XPHB.

Hunter's Senses.

You have proficiency in the Perception, Stealth, or Survival skill.

Rampage.

When you use your Bite or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB with an attack, you can take a Bonus Action|XPHB to move up to half your Speed|XPHB and make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XPHB using your Bite.

name: Kalamer Landwalker (Merfolk)
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Amphibious.

You can breathe air and water.

Blessing of the Sea.

You have two forms: your natural merfolk form and that of a landwalker. As a Magic action, you can shape-shift to change from your merfolk form to your landwalker form. While in your landwalker form, your fish-like fluke splits into 2 legs. Your Speed|XPHB increases by 20 feet, but your Swim Speed|XPHB is reduced to 0.

You stay in the new form until you take a Magic action to revert to your merfolk form.

Karakala Lore.

You have proficiency in the Nature, Performance, or Survival skill.

name: Ruinbound
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Personal Symbiont.

You are bound to an alien entity that is part of your body and can't be removed. Your symbiont possesses a minor supernatural ability, which it can use on your behalf. Choose a cantrip from the following list: Acid Splash, Guidance (self only), Light, Mage Hand, Mind Sliver, Poison Spray, Resistance (self only), Shocking Grasp, Thorn Whip. You can switch to a different cantrip from this list whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).

Symbiont Mastery.

You can attune to one magic item that has the Symbiotic Nature property without it counting toward the maximum number of magic items you can attune to. In addition, whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, you can end your Attunement|XPHB to a magic item that has the Symbiotic Nature property. When doing so, you can ignore any restrictions that require you be targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic before the symbiont can be removed.

Unnatural Resilience.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Poison damage. You also have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

1d8Mutation
1Unnatural Hair. Is your hair an unusual color? Ectoplasmic in nature? Does it move of its own accord?
2Unusual Skin. Is your skin transparent? Slick? An unnatural color?
3Aberrant Eyes. Are your eyes luminous? Invisible? Do they resemble the eyes of an animal, or are they seemingly absent?
4Strange Appetites. Do you prefer your food charred? Do you eat flowers, or can you only eat living things?
5Living Tattoos. You appear to have exotic tattoos across your body. They slowly and constantly change, and you have no control over the design. Do they show images or words, or are they incomprehensible?
6Ageless. The passage of time affects your appearance differently than others. Do you appear old beyond your years, or look surprisingly young no matter your age? As you grow older, do you look younger?
7Inexplicable Hearing. You have no visible ears, yet you can hear clearly. Does sound feel different to you? How do you experience it?
8Extra Joints. You have one or more extra joints. Is it just an unusual joint in your fingers, or can you bend your entire leg backward?

traits.name: Personal Symbiont
traits.description:
You are bound to an alien entity that is part of your body and can't be removed. Your symbiont possesses a minor supernatural ability, which it can use on your behalf. Choose a cantrip from the following list: Acid Splash, Guidance (self only), Light, Mage Hand, Mind Sliver, Poison Spray, Resistance (self only), Shocking Grasp, Thorn Whip. You can switch to a different cantrip from this list whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).

traits.description: You can attune to one magic item that has the Symbiotic Nature property without it counting toward the maximum number of magic items you can attune to. In addition, whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, you can end your Attunement|XPHB to a magic item that has the Symbiotic Nature property. name: Sahuagin
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Swift Swimmer.

You have a Swim speed equal to your Speed|XPHB.

Blood Frenzy.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can enter a blood frenzy until the start of your next turn. During this time, you have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points|XPHB.

You can use this Bonus Action|XPHB a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Natural Armor.

You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class|XPHB equals 12 plus your Dexterity modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

Limited Amphibiousness.

You can breathe air and underwater, but you need to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.
